# unifi_network_firewall_rule (Resource)

A UniFi classic firewall rule (`firewallrule`, legacy `/rest`). Matches on protocol, addresses/ports, networks, firewall groups, and connection state within a ruleset (chain). The newer zone-based firewall is a separate surface (a later phase).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) What to do with matching traffic: `accept`, `drop`, or `reject`.
- `name` (String) Rule name.
- `rule_index` (Number) Evaluation order within the ruleset (lower runs first). Must be unique within the ruleset — the provider rejects a duplicate at apply time.
- `ruleset` (String) The chain this rule belongs to, e.g. `LAN_IN`, `WAN_OUT`, `GUEST_LOCAL` (and `*v6_*` variants).

### Optional

- `dst_address` (String) Destination IP or CIDR to match.
- `dst_firewall_group_ids` (Set of String) Destination firewall groups (`unifi_network_firewall_group` ids) to match.
- `dst_network_id` (String) Destination network (`unifi_network_network` id) to match.
- `dst_network_type` (String) Destination network match type (e.g. `NETv4`, `ADDRv4`).
- `dst_port` (String) Destination port or range to match.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `icmp_typename` (String) ICMP type name to match (when `protocol = icmp`).
- `ipsec` (String) IPsec matching: `match-ipsec` (only IPsec traffic) or `match-none` (only non-IPsec).
- `logging` (Boolean) Log packets that match this rule.
- `protocol` (String) Protocol to match: `all`, `tcp`, `udp`, `tcp_udp`, `icmp`, or a protocol number.
- `protocol_match_excepted` (Boolean) Match every protocol *except* the one in `protocol`.
- `protocol_v6` (String) IPv6 protocol to match (for `*v6_*` rulesets).
- `src_address` (String) Source IP or CIDR to match.
- `src_firewall_group_ids` (Set of String) Source firewall groups (`unifi_network_firewall_group` ids) to match.
- `src_network_id` (String) Source network (`unifi_network_network` id) to match.
- `src_network_type` (String) Source network match type (e.g. `NETv4`, `ADDRv4`).
- `src_port` (String) Source port or range to match.
- `state_established` (Boolean) Match established connections.
- `state_invalid` (Boolean) Match invalid connections.
- `state_new` (Boolean) Match new connections.
- `state_related` (Boolean) Match related connections.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Controller object ID (`_id`). Import key.
- `setting_preference` (String) Controller auto/manual toggle (read-only).
